mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, which raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during episodes where GDPC1 falls below -2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average by more than 3% for four consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12M MA by >3% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO contractions exceeding 3% below the 12-month moving average for four months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in HOUST and a fall in RSAFS over the same month signals a shift from speculative investment to real demand, which historically precedes a stabilization in equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 0% MoM and RSAFS < 0% MoM in the same month
regime_hint: transition from speculative to real demand
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST rises and RSAFS falls in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in FEDFUNDS and a decline in CPIAUCSL over two consecutive months signals a successful disinflationary tightening, which supports equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > previous month and CPIAUCSL < previous month for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during episodes of simultaneous FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL declines for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in PAYEMS above its 12-month moving average by more than 1% for three consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 12M MA by >1% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average by more than 1% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in GDPC1 for four consecutive quarters signals a deepening economic contraction, which consistently precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during four consecutive quarters of GDPC1 decline.
